category_title: At-risk students in technical tracks who exhibit attention-seeking behaviors, restlessness, and kinetic learning needs
minimal_context: The student is using SONAR software and headphones in the keyboard lab to learn their individual instrumental parts for 'Count On Me'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put on your headphones and use the SONAR software to learn your individual instrumental parts for 'Count On Me'.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not sure what we are doing. I am a bit blur.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the software and try to figure it out on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Plays a few notes on the keyboard) I am practising but it is a bit blurred.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on it individually and quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes off headphones and stops doing his work for some time) I am frustrated because I cannot figure out what to do.
